text:
Maya: Flagging a few quick QA/a11y items on the embeddings rerank preview: export copy ambiguity, small relevance tokens low contrast in dark theme, and keyboard focus oddness when opening previews. Screenshot attached.

design-bot: build-4921 preview: https://ci/internal/4921/snap.png

Olivia: Re: pills 12px text on dark needs 4.5:1. Current #6B7280 fails. Suggest text #E5E7EB on pill-bg rgba(255,255,255,0.06) -> 0.08. Also bump hit area to 14px.

Jamal: Front-end: easy to change color and hit area. Will add a compact-mode variable so pills don't collapse into the row hover color.

Ankur: a11y: add aria-describedby for relevance token with "Higher = more relevant". For sorting, include aria-sort on header and update an aria-live region when users toggle sort.

Priya: Copy: "Export vectors" confused customers. Recommend primary CTA "Download vectors (CSV)" and secondary menu with "Download NDJSON (for eval)" and "Copy to clipboard". Tooltip: "Includes id, embedding, metadata".

Olivia: Agreed. Also add sample CSV header in tooltip so people know column order.

Maya: Focus issue: when modal opens SR focus lands on close X. Want initial focus on preview title or first result.

Jamal: I'll set initialFocus to '#preview-title' and add denser focus outline in compact tables. Also wire export button aria-label "Download vectors as CSV".

Ankur: Keyboard: add shortcut D to download focused item, Shift+D for batch export. Document in keyboard help. Ensure modifier behavior is consistent.

Priya: Filename suggestion: vectors-<workspace>-YYYYMMDD.csv default, allow custom prefix in export modal.

Olivia: I'll ship a quick mock with updated pill colors, CTA copy, tooltip text, and keyboard hints by EOD. Add a11y checklist for the PR.

Maya: Thanks 1et's smoke on staging after PR and run a short accessibility pass.
